links.outcome: MRI sequence classification accuracy of multimodal LLMs on zero-shot benchmark
links.effect: Sequence accuracy 97.7% ChatGPT-4o, 93.1% Gemini 2.5 Pro, 73.1% Claude 4 Opus (p<0.001); models vary significantly on specific sequence classification.
links.quote: MRI sequence classification accuracy was 97.7% for ChatGPT-4o, 93.1% for Gemini 2.5 Pro, and 73.1% for Claude 4 Opus (p < 0.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic/classification accuracy of multimodal LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude 4 Opus, Gemini 2.5 Pro) on identifying brain MRI sequences from 130 images using zero-shot prompts without testing specific deployment practices.
